text:
jordan_support: Customer reports intermittent routing to EU despite client sending region=us. High p99 latency and billing spikes. They say it happens ~1-2% of requests. Can we triage?

jordan_support: Example request we got from their logs (sanitized):
```
GET /v1/generate?region=us HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
X-Client-Region: 
User-Agent: acme-sdk/1.4.2
```
Note the header is present but empty. Router logs show selection: eu-west-1.

lee_infra: @jordan_support can you paste the router decision log for one of those requests? need the exact matching keys and policy in the log line. Also which SDK version? you mentioned 1.4.2.

jordan_support: SDK is acme-sdk 1.4.2 (their internal wrapper) but using our JS SDK under the hood. Router log (timestamped):
```
[router] req=abc123 client_region_header="" client_region_param="us" routing_policy=header_first selected_region=eu-west-1 fallback_reason="header present but empty -> treat as value"
```
They're on hosted us-east for other requests.

region-router-bot: Decision trace: header_first policy -> evaluated header -> header string length == 0 -> treated as "present" -> attempted to resolve region='' -> no match -> applied fallback_region=eu-west-1 per tenant defaults.

tara_engineer: This looks like we treat an empty header as a provided preference (and then fall through to tenant fallback) instead of treating it as absent. Expected behavior: empty string should be ignored and we should fall back to query param / SDK param if present.

tara_engineer: Quick repro: curl example that triggers the misroute:
```bash
curl -s -D - -H "X-Client-Region: " "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=us"
```
works for me locally when I simulate header-first policy.

lee_infra: Could be an ingress layer that normalizes headers and keeps header present with empty value. We should either strip empty headers at the LB, or change router to consider empty string equivalent to missing. Which is faster?

tara_engineer: Fastest path: patch router's header existence check to `if header && header.trim().length > 0` instead of current `if header != null`. Small change, unit tests + canary should be fine. 

jordan_support: Customer needs immediate mitigation — can we flip policy to param_first for their tenant while patch is prepared?

lee_infra: We have per-tenant override flags. I can flip to `param_first` for tenant acme-corp for the next 60m. Will do after change approval.

deploy-bot: Scheduled config flip for tenant=acme-corp: policy -> param_first (start=1976543300, duration=3600s) ; will monitor 10m after start.

tara_engineer: I'll open a hotfix PR (small change + tests). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/router/pulls/4521 (working draft). Patch note: treat empty header as absent; add unit + integ test that mixes empty header + query param.

jordan_support: Thanks — can you add a regression test for SDKs that send `X-Client-Region: ""`? customer supplied reproducible 1-liner.

tara_engineer: Yep will add. Plan: 1) temporary tenant override -> param_first (lee) 2) merge hotfix + canary (tara) 3) monitor for 24h and roll to prod (deploy-bot + lee).

jordan_support: Customer notified and will verify once override is live. Please @me when canary is green. :thumbsup:

lee_infra: Override applied at 1976543300, initial metrics look good. routing error rate for acme-corp dropped from 1.7% -> 0.01% in first 2 minutes. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: 2 nodes updated (router v3.12.4+hotfix-canary). Health checks passing.

tara_engineer: PR is ready for review, tests added. aiming for merge + full rollout after 1h of canary stability.

jordan_support: Awesome — closing the support escalation if no further regressions reported by customer in the next 24h. Will reopen if needed.

lee_infra: Follow-up: ops ticket #OP-8817 created to audit header handling across edge-proxies and SDKs so we don't get other empty-header cases.

jordan_support: thanks team.
